name: Vestige Operator Lite
description: Deterministic pre-tool gate: classifies every shell command against a closed rule set (OP-000..OP-010 STOP, OP-S01..S17 SHADOW), follows cd / shell variables / heredocs, sees through GuardFall-class obfuscation, writes hash-chained receipts. The gate is bundled. Shadow mode by default — flip with: echo enforce > ~/.operator/mode
